subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should yielded cron parents remain an internal nonterminal waiting state until final synthesis, or should `deferred` become a persisted public Gateway, SDK, CLI, and UI status?
rationale: Both approaches can fix premature completion, but they create materially different compatibility, automation, and operator contracts that cannot be selected from tests alone.

options.title: Keep Waiting Internal
options.body: Keep the cron run nonterminal until parent reconciliation and avoid adding a new public persisted status value.

options.title: Ship Public Deferred
options.body: Accept `deferred` as a supported terminal handoff status with explicit compatibility documentation, upgrade tests, and exact-head proof.

options.title: Split The Surfaces
options.body: Land the core cron and subagent lifecycle separately and coordinate Discord settlement with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95604.

recommendation.title: Keep Waiting Internal
recommendation.body: Keep the cron run nonterminal until parent reconciliation and avoid adding a new public persisted status value.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest available history signal is recent work on yielded subagent pausing in the same registry lifecycle.
